name: imrotate
expr: R90 = imrotate(J, 90); Rn = imrotate(J, 30, 'nearest'); Rb = imrotate(J, 30, 'bilinear'); Rc = imrotate(J, 30, 'bicubic');
comment: MATLAB imrotate — angle/method coverage vs MATLAB R2025b. 90 deg exact (loose, rot90 permutation); 30 deg nearest (half-to-even source rounding — Rn(3,2) is the .5-tie pixel that was off by one), bilinear, bicubic interior values + sums. Bit-equal (tol=1e-6 for interpolation; nearest/90 exact). Octave ships imrotate in the image pkg.
